sections.text:
Installing new or Recharged
C02 cylinders

items:
Remove
 the transport caps from the cylinder valves.

Install
 the weighing bracket and secure the cylinders into the bracket.

Screw
 on the connection hose between the cylinder valves and the CO2 manifold.

Install
 the cylinder valve opening device. Make sure the lever is aligned with the
 slot in the valve head so it can move to the horizontal position when
 required.

Insert
 the connecting pin of the tie-rods and the saw-toothed slide.

Ensure
 that the whole assembly is free to move.

Remove
 the safety pins to release the manual valve heads. Be sure that all systems
 are in working order and the detection system is switched back to the ON
 position (to prevent accidental gas discharge ).

Reset
 the electrical discharge trigger switch manually by pressing down the button
 provided at the base of this
 contact switch.

text:
Fire Fighting System | Technical Procedure
Introduction
The purpose of this document is to describe the
 various inspection/maintenance procedures (General Inspections), which must be
 performed on this fire protection equipment. The maintenance/inspection
 requirements for daily D1, monthly M1, 3month M3 and annual Y1 intervals are
 included in this document
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety 
 and healthy equipments safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
Transformer outage is required.
Never
 perform any work on the transformer before isolating the fire protection
 system.
You
 must carry portable fire extinguisher when entering the transformer room
 after the fire.
Vent
 the flooded transformer room before entering it after the fire.
Any
 person inside the transformer room must immediately leave it after hearing
 the fire alarm.
Any
 doors leading to the room must be kept closed.
To
 prevent the accidental discharge of the system, do not touch the pilot
 cylinder weighing device inside the transformer room.
Tools and Equipment
Safety Helmet, Safety Shoes.
Work to be carried out
Daily inspection (I1-D1)
Check for the correct weight of
 the CO2 cylinders, the cylinder must be taken and recharged, if a loss of CO2 discharge is detected.
Monthly inspection 
(I2-M1)
Check
 the weight of the pilot cylinders.
3 Month Inspection 
(I3-M3)
Check freedom of movement of the fusible link wire rope.
Annual
Inspection (I4-Y1)
Perform
 a functional test of the system manually by discharging one or two
 cylinders. You must follow these steps:
Make
 sure that the stand- by CO2 cylinders are fully charged.
Unscrew
 the pneumatic release device of the second or third cylinder only and
 carefully hang it down by its connecting hose.
Turn
 slowly the valve of the required pilot cylinder which is responsible for
 operating the system on the transformer, by its hand-wheel counter-clockwis
 e fully open.
Observe
 the operating of the drop curtain during the test.
Installing new or Recharged
C02 cylinders
Remove
 the transport caps from the cylinder valves.
Install
 the weighing bracket and secure the cylinders into the bracket.
Screw
 on the connection hose between the cylinder valves and the CO2 manifold.
Install
 the cylinder valve opening device. Make sure the lever is aligned with the
 slot in the valve head so it can move to the horizontal position when
 required.
Insert
 the connecting pin of the tie-rods and the saw-toothed slide.
Ensure
 that the whole assembly is free to move.
Remove
 the safety pins to release the manual valve heads. Be sure that all systems
 are in working order and the detection system is switched back to the ON
 position (to prevent accidental gas discharge ).
Reset
 the electrical discharge trigger switch manually by pressing down the button
 provided at the base of this
 contact switch.
